notes: Overview: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Strong search/insights product that is adding semantic search + assistant features across product and support.
Buying signal: Started with Hosted API for embeddings to validate quality and relevance. Positive relevance vs. existing tf-idf baseline on 1M doc subset.

POC ask: end-to-end evaluation for embeddings + semantic search. Must show: ingest pipeline, vector DB integration, query latency at 50 QPS, nightly batch reindexing of 500k vectors/day, and cost model for scaling to 12M vectors.

Performance targets: 95th percentile query latency < 100ms for semantic search queries, tail latency under 200ms during batch jobs. Throughput target 50 QPS sustained with occasional spikes to 150 QPS.
Cost sensitivity: target per-embedding cost <= $0.0009 for production; overall platform cost target to fit ARR estimate. Finance will push back if Dedicated uplift > 1.5x Hosted API estimate.
Data & security: EU data residency requirement for EU customers, SSO/SAML for staff, audit logging, and KMS for customer-managed keys. Legal flagged retention controls for PII in vectors.
Technical preferences: Prefer managed Pinecone integration but open to Milvus/Weaviate if cost improves. They run Airflow for ETL and want sample DAGs for Redwood embedding jobs.
Quote from CTO (call): 'Quality is great — embeddings beat our baseline, but we need an operational story for nightly indexing and cost predictability.'
